messages.subject: scrollable text box?
parts: I would like to add a status window on my shiny app that prints text but does not increase in height. The user should be able to scroll through the text. I know this is possible in HTML with something like <div style="overflow: auto ...">, but I can't figure out how to implement it in shiny. Any tips would be appreciated. Thanks.

messages.author: a1bf76ab9a5a2d4b
messages.subject: Re: scrollable text box?
parts:
You can do the same thing by addind the `overflow: auto` to your app's CSS.

runApp(shinyApp(
  ui = fluidPage(
    shiny::tags$head(shiny::tags$style(shiny::HTML(
      "#text { font-size: 50px; height: 200px; overflow: auto; }"
    ))),
    div(id = "text", paste(names(tags), collapse = ", "))
  ),
  server = function(input, output, session) {
  }
))
